commentary.T1: Aggregate T1 count 7 concentrated: Poincaré 1898 = 4, three other papers = 1 each. Einstein 1905 also = 4. Einstein does not have less T1 discussion than 'the precursors'; he ties the single most vocal precursor.
commentary.T2: Aggregate T2 count 25 distributed across FitzGerald, Larmor, Lodge, Michelson, Rayleigh at 3-4 each. Einstein 1905 also = 4. Multiple precursors match Einstein on T2 volume.
commentary.unique_to_einstein: No precursor paper has BOTH T1 count ≥ 4 AND T2 count ≥ 4 in the same document. Einstein 1905 is the unique case of simultaneous 4:4 balance.
